answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 10329 Country: India Title: taraweeh ki namaz me athieeeyat ki mikdar me baitne ke waqt, musalliyan ko pura waqt(atheeeyat, dua e masura aur durud sharifpadne ke liye) nahi milta, to kya unki namaaz ho jayeegi. Question: taraweeh ki namaz me athieeeyat ki mikdar me baitne ke waqt, musalliyan ko pura waqt(atheeeyat, dua e masura aur durud sharifpadne ke liye) nahi milta, to kya unki namaaz ho jayeegi. Answer ID: 10329 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 113/113=M/1429) The salah of all the people will be valid, but the imam should not shorten the qadah to an extent that people find it difficult to complete their al-tahiyaat . He should mind those following him and should not hurry up. Yes in tarawih , if more delay is causing weariness and fatigue in people then it is allowable to recite short durood and dua . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
